What We Do

Our Services

From pre-vertical site design and construction plans to full project management, JDM delivers the engineering expertise that builders and investors need to move with confidence.

01
Civil Site Design

Full civil site design packages including grading plans, drainage, utilities, and construction drawings ready for permitting.

02
Construction Plans

Complete construction plan sets for builders and investors — from initial layout through final permit-ready drawings.

03
Project Management

End-to-end project management from concept through construction, keeping timeline, budget, and compliance on track.

04
Residential Communities

Pre-vertical site design and civil engineering for single-family subdivisions, townhomes, and master-planned residential developments.

05
Commercial & Retail

Civil design and project management for commercial centers, retail developments, mixed-use sites, and investment properties.

06
Public Works

Civil engineering support for publicly-funded projects including pedestrian access, roadway improvements, utilities, and civic infrastructure.

Who We Are

Engineering
with Purpose

JDM Consultants LLC is a Minority-Owned civil engineering, design, and consulting firm founded by Darrell Johnson, PE in Atlanta, GA. With $750M+ in development led across Georgia, JDM brings precision engineering and full project ownership to every engagement.

  • $750M+ in development led across Georgia
  • Residential, commercial & public works specialist
  • Licensed Professional Civil Engineer (PE)
  • Minority-Owned & certified small business
  • Full project management — concept through permitting

Meet the Founder

Darrell Johnson, PE

Darrell Johnson is a licensed Professional Civil Engineer and the founder of JDM Consultants LLC. Over the course of his career he has led civil design, project management, and consulting for more than $750M in development across Georgia — spanning residential communities, commercial and retail centers, and public works infrastructure.

After building his career at leading engineering firms across the Southeast, Darrell founded JDM to build something of his own: a firm that pairs the technical depth of a large practice with the responsiveness and personal accountability of a small business. JDM is proud to be Minority-Owned, and Darrell brings that same sense of ownership to every client engagement.
